subject.title: fix: stop model fallback on sandbox provisioning failures

question: Should sandbox backend-provisioning failures globally abort configured model fallback chains once the missing-image behavior is demonstrated live?
rationale: The proposed classification deliberately changes compatibility behavior for existing sandboxed runs, and the affected setup boundary has a clear historical owner even though the narrower bug report supports the direction.

options.title: Require live proof and owner confirmation
options.body: Keep the typed provisioning classification, but require a redacted missing-image/backend-startup transcript proving one attempt and no fallback transition before merge.

options.title: Pause for a narrower policy decision
options.body: Hold the PR if sandbox owners want a more limited taxonomy of provision failures or an explicit distinction between retryable startup errors and terminal setup errors.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep the typed provisioning classification, but require a redacted missing-image/backend-startup transcript proving one attempt and no fallback transition before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-main history on the sandbox context and backend boundary being changed.
